content.text: Rear-facing car seat in back seat from birth until highest height or wt allowed by seat manufacturer (⍉age cutoff)
SIDS: unexplained sudden death <1yo - leading cause of death 1mo-1y

SIDS RF: 2-4mo · preterm/LBW · prone · soft surface · loose bedding · bumpers · pillows · weighted blankets · inclines >10° · bed sharing · overheating · maternal smoke/drugs in preg · ⍉ or late prenatal care · mother <20y · swaddling once able to roll
SIDS protective: room sharing w.o bed sharing until ~6mo · firm flat surface · supine · human milk until ~6mo · pacifier · fan · vax · regular tummy time
Sleeping in car seat outside car ↑SIDS risk
MVC inj & death = common cause of childhood morbidity & mortality
Back passenger seat = safest position · ⍉leave infant unattended in car seat
Follow manufacturer instructions · replace car seat after accident
Should be back to birth wt by 2wks - gain ~30g/d (0-3mo) · 20g/d (3-6mo) · 10g/d (6-12mo)
Term neonates may lose up to 10% birth wt in 1st few days
Breastfed gain faster 1st 3-4mo then slower - formula-fed slower then faster
Growth pulsatile & seasonal (↑spring/summer) · twins smaller than singletons until 30mo
Falls - back to sleep - gun safety in home
Should be back to birth wt by 2wks
Do ⍉need to eat during night after 3mo
Parents getting enough rest · returning to work
- cereals · fruits · veggies · protein (wait several days b/n introduction of new foods)
- ok once learn to roll over themselves
Assist w sleeping thru night - set simple limits/rules
May turn car seat to forward-facing w harness once rear-facing seat's height/wt limit outgrown
Childproof home - dangling cords · poisons/medicines · guns
Supervise near H2O · pets · mowers · streets · driveways
Praise good behavior - talk · sing · read to baby
Pot handles to back of stove - window guards · safety locks · stair gates
Eat meals as family - let child decide how much to eat
Decline in eating w slower growth
Fostering independence - ignore annoying but ⍉unsafe behaviors
Forward-facing car seat w harness in back seat until seat's height/wt limit
Variety of healthy foods - let child pick - ⍉struggles
Begin toilet training when child = ready
May transition to belt-positioning booster seat once forward-facing seat's height/wt limit outgrown
H2O safety - teach child emergency phone numbers
Family rules · respect for authority · Rt vs wrong
Lap/shoulder seat belt in back seat for 8-12yo
Use both lap & shoulder belt - once adult belt fits properly
